next_falsifier: On customer-authorized or fully public aggregate statements, measure detection of missing account-month invoices relative to a finance-team baseline, counting source interruptions vs actual backbill surprises; verify existing vendor capabilities, municipal procurement requirements, and willingness-to-pay before sale.
guardrails: Do not assert recovery or liability from a missing invoice.
No new paid tools or subscriptions.
No claim filings or vendor disputes.
prototype_assumptions: 45-day billing grace period is an illustrative user-configurable assumption, NOT a tariff rule.
CSV/ERP parsing and provider-specific document authority not implemented.
False positives likely for delayed utility billing, consolidated bills, partial-period accounts, or new account IDs.
